name: POST /api/leadflow/saved-views - store a filter, never a result
description:
Saves a contact-list view. THE FILTER IS STORED, NEVER A RESULT SET: a stored result says "5" forever while the queue it described moves on, and a sidebar count a month stale is worse than no count because somebody plans their morning around it.

A PRIVATE VIEW NEEDS AN OWNER, enforced by a CHECK constraint as well as here — one with no owner is visible to nobody and deletable by nobody, which is a row that exists only to confuse the next person who finds it. QA: measured live.

testCases.name: A view is stored with its filter, scope and pin state
NEGATIVE: a scope outside private, team, organization
NEGATIVE: no Authorization header at all
NEGATIVE: a bearer token that does not verify

errorCases.message: scope must be one of private, team, organization
errorCases.when: the name is empty, the scope is unknown, or a private view has no owner.

errorCases.message: Authorization header with a bearer token is required
errorCases.when: the Authorization header is absent, empty, or uses a scheme other than Bearer.

errorCases.message: Session token is invalid or expired
errorCases.when: a Bearer token was presented but does not verify.
